gloss: visit to a sick or injured person, sympathy visit

definitions.gloss: visit to someone who is sick or in trouble
definitions.explanation: The act of visiting someone to express sympathy or concern.
A gift brought when visiting someone who is ill or has experienced misfortune.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{見舞|みま}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to visit someone at the hospital.
examples.notes: お{見舞|みま}い is the polite form

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧{見舞|みま}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I sent a letter of sympathy for the disaster.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入院|にゅういん}→入院：02091_nyuuin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{見舞|みま}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きたい→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ですが→です：09485_desu⟧、⟦{面会|めんかい}→面会：15925_menkai⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦ですか→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I'd like to visit my friend who's been hospitalized. What time do visiting hours start?

examples.japanese: {見舞|みま}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品|しな}→品：03192_shina⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
お{見舞|みま}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}った→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I sent flowers as a get-well gift.

notes:
Usually used with the polite prefix お as お{見舞|みま}い.

TYPES OF {見舞|みま}い:
・⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧{見舞|みま}い (visiting the sick)
・⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧{見舞|みま}い (disaster condolences)
・⟦{暑中|しょちゅう}→暑中：noentry⟧{見舞|みま}い (summer greeting card)
・⟦{残暑|ざんしょ}→残暑：08559_zansho⟧{見舞|みま}い (late summer greeting card)
・⟦{寒中|かんちゅう}→寒中：noentry⟧{見舞|みま}い (winter greeting card)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・お{見舞|みま}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go visit someone)
・お{見舞|みま}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げる→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧ (formal expression of sympathy)
・⟦{見舞金|みまいきん}→見舞金：noentry⟧ (monetary gift for illness/disaster)
